literal_meaning: পেটে টালা দেওয়া (covering or plastering the stomach)
figurative_meaning_en: Filling one's belly at someone else's expense
example_sentences_in_bangla: সে সবসময় বন্ধুদের খরচে পেট টালা করে।
আজকের দাবতটা পেট টালা হয়ে গেল, কারণ হোস্টের টাকায় সব।
example_sentences_in_english: He always fills his belly at his friends' expense.
Today's feast turned into filling our bellies at the host's cost.
note: This idiom reflects Bengali cultural nuances around hospitality and the subtle critique of over-reliance on others' generosity.
